title: The Captured Images thumbnail rail cannot be scrolled with an ordinary mouse wheel and has no scrollbar
reasoning: The claimed code is present and the primary complaint is fixed: image_thumbnail_strip.dart now owns a ScrollController, wraps the rail in Listener(onPointerSignal: _handleRailScroll) + Scrollbar(thumbVisibility: true), and takes the scrollbar's 10px out of the list's own bottom padding so kAnalyticsThumbnailRailHeight is unchanged (children are Expanded, so no overflow). I severed the wiring (onPointerSignal: null) and the wheel test went red, so the test is bound to production. BUT the fixer's stated invariant 'nothing double-scrolls' is false on both paths I measured. A bare Listener callback does NOT consume a pointer signal, and the rail sits inside session_tab.dart's SingleChildScrollView (line 300): one 220px notch moved the rail 220px AND the page 220px, so the rail scrolls sideways while sliding off screen. And with shift held the rail's own Scrollable flips axes and claims the notch through the resolver while the Listener ALSO jumped — a 100px notch moved the rail 200px. Measured both with a scratch widget test before repairing.
evidence: Severed onPointerSignal -> 'a plain vertical wheel over the rail scrolls the rail' failed (Actual: 0.0); severed onTap -> inspector test failed. Scratch test pre-repair printed 'PLAIN RAIL=220.0 PAGE=220.0' and 'SHIFT RAIL=200.0 PAGE=0.0'; post-repair 'PLAIN RAIL=220.0 PAGE=0.0' and 'SHIFT RAIL=100.0 PAGE=0.0'. 6/6 tests green in packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/analytics/widgets/thumbnail_rail_reachable_test.dart.
repairSummary: _handleRailScroll now registers with GestureBinding.instance.pointerSignalResolver instead of calling jumpTo directly, so the notch is consumed (page no longer scrolls with it) and the handler loses to the rail's own Scrollable under shift (no more double move). Overscroll at either end still falls through to the page. Added two tests to thumbnail_rail_reachable_test.dart: 'the wheel notch that moves the rail does not also move the page' (rail inside a SingleChildScrollView, asserts page.offset == 0) and 'shift+wheel moves the rail once, not twice' (asserts exactly 100px). NOT edited: packages/skotiq_ui/lib/src/components/adaptive_tab_bar.dart:143 has the identical un-consumed Listener pattern this was copied from and has the same shift double-scroll bug — shared UI package, left for the widgets area.
